name: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Tenshi no Akogare
original_name: その花びらにくちづけを　天使のあこがれ
source:
Aihara Ringo, who is in her first year at the nursing school, has decided to room with Takao Chiaki, an old family friend from back home.

Ringo idolizes Chiaki and has made it her life’s goal to become a respectable nurse just like her.  However…

Once they actually start living together, Ringo comes to realize that Chiaki takes much worse care of herself than she imagined, and is at the same time a very physically affectionate person.

Will the disparity between Chiaki the goddess and the Chiaki who delights in sexual harassment drive Ringo crazy!?

[[url=http://petalsgarden.axypb.net/2013/03/22/yurin-yurin-official-website-3]Translated synopsis[/url]]
translation:
相原苹果是护理学校一年级学生，她决定和来自故乡的老朋友高尾千秋合租。

苹果非常崇拜千秋，并把成为像她一样值得尊敬的护士作为人生目标。然而……

真正开始同居后，苹果才意识到千秋比她想象中更不会照顾自己，同时还是一个非常喜欢肢体接触的人。

女神千秋和那个以性骚扰为乐的千秋之间的落差，会把苹果逼疯吗！？
